course.title: AP Precalculus
course.description: Build the function toolkit that calculus depends on: how quantities change together, polynomial and rational functions, exponential and logarithmic models, and trigonometric and polar functions.
course.previewDescription: Study how outputs change with inputs, then use polynomial, rational, exponential, logarithmic, and trigonometric functions to describe patterns and build models.

unit.title: Polynomial and Rational Functions
unit.description: See how outputs change with inputs, then use rates of change, zeros, end behavior, asymptotes, and holes to describe polynomial and rational functions and build models from them.

topics.title: Change in Tandem
topics.summary: How input values and output values of a function vary together: domain and range, increasing and decreasing, concavity, and zeros.

topics.title: Rates of Change
topics.summary: Average rates of change over intervals, rates of change at a point, and what the sign of a rate of change says about how two quantities vary together.

topics.title: Rates of Change in Linear and Quadratic Functions
topics.summary: Average rates of change for sequences, linear functions, and quadratic functions, secant lines, and how the change in average rates of change reveals concavity.

topics.title: Polynomial Functions and Rates of Change
topics.summary: Degree, leading term, and leading coefficient, relative and absolute extrema, extrema between real zeros, and points of inflection.

topics.title: Polynomial Functions and Complex Zeros
topics.summary: Zeros and linear factors, multiplicity, complex zeros and conjugates, degree from successive differences, and even and odd functions.

topics.title: Polynomial Functions and End Behavior
topics.summary: Limit notation for end behavior and why the degree and the sign of the leading term determine the end behavior of a polynomial function.

topics.title: Rational Functions and End Behavior
topics.summary: Rational functions as quotients of polynomials, and how the quotient of the leading terms gives the end behavior, horizontal asymptotes, and slant asymptotes.

topics.title: Rational Functions and Zeros
topics.summary: The real zeros of a rational function, and how the real zeros of its numerator and denominator determine where it is positive or negative.

topics.title: Rational Functions and Vertical Asymptotes
topics.summary: Where the graph of a rational function has a vertical asymptote, and how one-sided limits describe the output values near it.

topics.title: Rational Functions and Holes
topics.summary: When the graph of a rational function has a hole instead of a vertical asymptote, and how a limit locates the hole.

topics.title: Equivalent Representations of Polynomial and Rational Expressions
topics.summary: Factored and standard forms, polynomial long division, and the binomial theorem, and which form answers which question.

topics.title: Transformations of Functions
topics.summary: Additive and multiplicative transformations: translations, dilations, and reflections, combined transformations, and their effect on domain, range, and asymptotes.

topics.title: Function Model Selection and Assumption Articulation
topics.summary: Choosing a linear, quadratic, polynomial, or piecewise-defined model from a data set or context, and stating the assumptions and domain and range restrictions of a model.

topics.title: Function Model Construction and Application
topics.summary: Constructing polynomial, piecewise-defined, and rational models from conditions, transformations, or regression, and applying a model to answer questions with units.
